topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 145 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 21 ERC20 tokens, 4 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 41 common project-authored base contract(s) (balancerpooltoken, vaultguard, poolinfo). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
